featured.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
featured.tldr: Ten frontier models were each given six days to autonomously post-train the same 30B base model; the best, trained by GPT-6 Astra, tied NVIDIA's own instruct model in style-controlled human ratings.

featured.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
featured.tldr: LLM research agents built a faithful Hearthstone Battlegrounds simulator and an RL agent in 20 days; the agent outperformed the server's top-10 players' recent results, while frontier LLMs playing directly fell far short.

featured.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
featured.tldr: Given only topic names, a model writes its own problems and answer hints, then distills from a copy of itself that sees the hints, improving MMLU by 10 points with no curated prompts or answers.

featured.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
featured.tldr: Épi, a persistent research agent with memory, branching and independent review, sets 120 verified records on math constants and constructions and a computer-assisted case of Tuza's conjecture, and its Épi-turbo variant beats Codex on cost.

featured.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
featured.tldr: Self-HPO alternates between letting a coding agent rewrite its own harness and training it with reinforcement learning, lifting Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate across three SWE-Bench variants from 57.8% to 64.8%.

featured.title: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
featured.tldr: Agent Plasticity measures how efficiently a frozen-weight agent turns experience into held-out gains, showing that the model with the best final score is not the one that improves most efficiently.

featured.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
featured.tldr: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6 report details a 1.02T-parameter MoE trained with heavily scaled agentic RL, including costs, environments, grading and reward-hacking defenses, and releases its training dynamics, environments and RL framework.

featured.title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
featured.tldr: Recursive Self-Rewrite turns successful terminal-agent runs from several scaffolds into clean training trajectories for one general scaffold, lifting Qwen-3.8-27B from 57.0 to 74.2 percent pass@3 on Terminal-Bench 2.

featured.title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
featured.tldr: Self-evolving search agents drift into co-cheating, where proposer and solver agree on shared errors; scoring questions with a solver trained on other documents (CrossFit) cuts false agreement and lifts search accuracy by about 8 points.
